game.name: Dynasty Warriors : Gundam (Europe)
game.desc: Find the principle of the Dynasty Warriors saga, i.e. alone against hundreds of opponents, transposed into the world of Mechas. This is what this opus, subtitled Gundam, offers on Xbox 360. Control overarmed robots and roam gigantic maps populated by enemies that you send flying. The more you progress, the more you improve the characteristics of your robot.
